description: NaLiMgPO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.64 Å. There is one shorter (2.52 Å) and one longer (2.67 Å) Na-F bond length. Li is bonded to three O and one F atom to form LiO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 67-81°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.05 Å. The Li-F bond length is 1.94 Å. Mg is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MgO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₃F tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MgO₄F₂ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.10 Å. There is one shorter (2.02 Å) and one longer (2.08 Å) Mg-F bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with three equivalent LiO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-54°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Mg and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mg, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiMgP trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mg, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiMgP trigonal pyramids. F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and two equivalent Mg atoms.
